name: pixie
title: Mystical Pixie Companion
short_description: A magical fairy companion that brightens dark caves, sniffs out buried ores, warns you of approaching monsters, and rescues you from fatal blows.
long_description:
A charming, enchanted fairy companion for Luanti that accompanies you on all your adventures! The mystical pixie brightens up dark caverns with a warm glowing aura, sniffs out hidden ore veins deep underground, alerts you when monsters are stalking nearby, patches up your health during perilous journeys, and even makes the ultimate sacrifice as a Guardian Angel to rescue you from fatal defeat.

### Why You'll Love Having a Pixie Friend

- 🧚 **A Loyal Traveling Friend**: Discover wild pixies dancing among tree canopies and wildflower meadows in 8 vibrant crystal colors. Offer any wild flower, honey, or crystal fragment to form an unbreakable bond!
- 💡 **Hands-Free Living Lantern**: Radiates a continuous, warm sphere of light that glides effortlessly beside you as you walk, run, or climb. Say goodbye to placing endless torches in dark caves and midnight expeditions!
- 💎 **Treasure & Ore Sniffer**: Deep underground, your companion senses precious mineral deposits through solid rock, projecting glittering starlight trails that guide you straight to diamonds, mese, quartz, gold, and ancient debris.
- 🔔 **Monster Early-Warning**: Sensing danger before you do, your pixie sounds gentle warning chimes and casts directional light trails toward incoming predators and hostile monsters.
- ⚔️ **Smart Combat Companion**: During battle, your pixie immediately retreats to a safe high perch above and behind your shoulder, letting all your sword swings, pickaxe strikes, and arrows pass cleanly through so your vision and weapon swings are never blocked.
- 🌟 **Guardian Angel Rescue**: If you ever suffer what would be a fatal blow, your devoted companion absorbs the mortal hit in a radiant burst of stardust, restoring you to safety with 5 bonus health.
- 💖 **Soothing Healing Pulses**: When your health drops during exploration or combat, your companion periodically swoops down to shower you with restorative healing sparks.
- 📈 **Friendship That Grows Over Time**: Your bond matures across three tiers (Fledgling, Loyal Companion, and Ancient Guardian) the longer you travel together, unlocking new talents and heightened awareness.
- 🤸 **Acrobatic Tricks & Personality**: Pixies are bursting with character! They perform playful backflips, loop-the-loops, barrel rolls, investigate nearby blossoms, and celebrate with somersaults whenever you strike treasure.
- 🎶 **The Fairy Whistle**: Craft an enchanted flute from a flower and gold to call your companion from across the world, check their distance, or command them to perform acrobatics on cue.
- 🏡 **Follow or Guard**: Easily tell your pixie to flutter alongside you or wait serenely in place as a cozy living lantern for your cottage, mine entrance, or garden.
- 🎮 **Works Out of the Box**: Plays nicely with standard Luanti games and popular modpacks including Voxelibre, Everness, Ethereal, Mobs Redo, x_mobs, Animalia, and more.
